title: All Glory, Laud, and Honor
description: All Glory, Laud, and Honor in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Theodulf of Orleans, first published in 820. The English translation is by John Mason Neale (1851). The tune, VALET WILL ICH DIR GEBEN, is by Melchior Teschner (1615). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: All glo-ry, laud and hon-or, To Thee, Re-deem-er, King, To Whom the lips of child-ren Made sweet ho-san-nas ring. Thou art the King of Is-rael, Thou Da-vid's ro-yal Son, Who in the Lord's Name com_-est, The King and Bless-ed One.

lines: To Whom the lips of children
Thou art the King of Israel,
Who in the Lord's Name comest,
To Whom the lips of children
And mortal men and all things
To Whom the lips of children
Our prayer and praise and anthems
To Whom the lips of children
They sang their hymns of praise;
To Whom the lips of children

topics: Children (see also God's Children - the Faithful)
